image_description: A black-and-white photograph of a vintage minibus, likely from the mid-20th century. The vehicle has a boxy shape with a rounded front end, large windshield, and side windows. It features destination signage on the roof and front. Several people are visible inside and near the bus. The setting appears to be an outdoor parking area or depot with buildings and trees in the background.
